final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.ID, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total as ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.total IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.ID, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as diff FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(cnt), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM step5
